description: Land Acquisition - Galakotuwa, Batuyaya, Rotawewa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (with survey numbers, boundaries, measurements, and ownership details) being acquired for public purposes in the Matale District. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
